title: ci: on 2026-10-14 five `Test (shard N/12)` jobs were cancelled at the 20-minute job limit while still passing tests, though their sibling shards finish in 7–13 minutes, so a green PR reads red until a re-run
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured defect on a public door, the required `Test` check. It turned green PRs red and cost each one a re-run cycle. Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post #9771) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, under the rule 「谁发现 flake 谁修或立单」. ⛔ Not a claim. For triage to grade and route.

`reach:` the required `Test` aggregate on objectui PRs. A shard cancelled at `timeout-minutes: 20` fails the aggregate, so a PR whose tests all passed reads red until a failed-jobs re-run. In the merge queue, a cancelled shard dequeues the PR (objectui#9503).

## The five cancellations, 2026-10-14 (all with no failing test)

| PR | head | shard | ran | siblings on the same head |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #12362 | (seat stand-down `6167357099`) | 8/12 and 10/12 | timed out | the rest green |
| #12377 | `abb4c59` | 2/12, job 115970222544 | 16:27:13 → 16:47:35 | 11 shards in 8–12 min |
| #12381 | `94b542a` | 2/12, job 116019574901 | 18:08:35 → 18:28:55 | (shard 7 also red, for its own reason) |
| #12383 | `9126ff6` | 1/12, job 116029528393 | 18:29:06 → 18:49:26 | 11 shards in 7–12 min |

The two logs read show `✓` lines arriving every one to five seconds for unrelated files (app-shell, plugin-detail, types, scripts), right up to "The operation was canceled". A failed-jobs re-run passed each time it was tried (#12362, #12377).

## Why this is not objectui#12208 again

objectui#12208 (closed) was about a shard whose own work had grown to near the limit. Today's shards are different:
- the same shard number finishes in about 10 minutes on one head and runs past 20 minutes on another;
- the cancelled shard varies (1, 2, 8, 10).

That points at runner speed variance, not shard weight. The reader can confirm it from `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` against these jobs' per-file timings.

## Ask (for the implementer to measure, ⛔ not a ruling)

- Measure whether the cancelled jobs ran on slower runners: per-file durations against the timings dataset, and the runner image or label.
- Then pick one:
  - headroom (a job limit sized to the observed slow-runner tail);
  - a lighter shard plan;
  - a runner pin.

  Whichever is picked, a cancelled shard must not stand in for a failed test.
- ⛔ No retry loop that hides a real hang. ⛔ No skip or quarantine.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` on objectui, closed included, `CI test shard cancelled 20 minute timeout slow runner job limit` → 5 hits. objectui#9499, #12208 and #9503 are this door's history, all closed. None covers a per-run runner-speed variance under the 12-shard plan.
